pack.booking: Onshore borrower in Hong Kong, offshore holdco in Singapore
pack.ubo: Lantern Family Trust, 62 percent, through two holding companies

paragraphs.text: Credit quality has weakened since the March review. The internal rating moved from 4 to 6, and the group is now Stage 2.

The onshore operating company remains current on scheduled repayment. The concern is the offshore holdco guarantee, which links the Hong Kong limit to a Singapore entity whose cash flow is not in the onshore statements.
Outstanding exposure is HKD 980,000,000 against a group limit of HKD 1,250,000,000. Headroom is HKD 270,000,000.
Deposits are HKD 146,000,000 and investment holdings are HKD 52,000,000. These balances are relationship context. They are not deducted from exposure.
Since 30 Jun 2026 the revolving tranche utilisation rose from 71 percent to 84 percent. No payment is past due.
The July credit proposal notes a delayed receivable from a mainland distributor. The proposal does not quantify a loss.
Eligible collateral is a first charge over a Kowloon commercial unit, valued at HKD 410,000,000 on 15 Aug 2026. Coverage of outstanding exposure is 0.42.

A corporate guarantee from Pacific Lantern International Pte. Ltd. covers the shortfall. Enforceability has not been reconfirmed in this review. Collateral and the guarantee mitigate risk. They do not eliminate it.
Two indicators are open: a two-notch rating migration, and utilisation sustained above 80 percent for two month-ends.
Moody's has not changed the public rating this quarter. A trade-press item on 18 Sep 2026 reports slower orders at the distributor. It is an external signal, not a covenant breach.
The group sits in wholesale trade. It is 6.7 percent of the illustrative CRO book. Two other trade names are on Stage 2, so a sector discussion belongs in the committee pack.
Ask the relationship manager for a monthly receivable ageing, and bring the guarantee back to legal for an enforceability check before the next annual review.

Recommended frequency is monthly until utilisation is back under 75 percent or the rating stabilises. Escalation is to the credit committee if a payment falls past due, or if the offshore guarantor reports a loss.

SRC-PDF-P12.passage: Distributor receipts slipped by about six weeks. Management expects collection in the December quarter. No specific-loss figure is stated.

SRC-RDW-LIMIT.passage: Group limit HKD 1,250,000,000. Outstanding HKD 980,000,000. Formula: headroom = limit − outstanding.

SRC-RDS-DEPOSIT.passage: Deposits HKD 146,000,000. Investment holdings HKD 52,000,000. Not netted against exposure.

SRC-RDW-UTIL.passage: Revolving tranche utilisation 84 percent. Prior month-end 30 Jun 2026 was 71 percent.

SRC-CWS-COLL.passage: Commercial unit, Kowloon, open-market value HKD 410,000,000. Coverage = 410,000,000 / 980,000,000 = 0.42.

SRC-EWS-01.passage: EWI open: rating migration of two notches since 31 Mar 2026.

SRC-EWS-02.passage: EWI open: utilisation above 80 percent at two consecutive month-ends.

SRC-MOODYS.passage: No public rating action on the group this quarter.

SRC-WEB-18SEP.passage: Report of slower orders at the named distributor. No primary financial statement attached.

SRC-RDS-SECTOR.passage: Industry: wholesale trade. Share of illustrative book: 6.7 percent.
